visualCharacteristics.purpose: Tabbed product/portfolio showcase where each tab holds an inner image-left/text-right slider
description: Text tab bar with yellow active underline; cream rounded panels holding an inner image-left/text-right slider

contentPattern.structure: cell 1: tab label; cell 2: one or more slides in order, each = image, then heading (h3), paragraph, CTA link. Each image starts a new slide; 2+ slides in a panel get prev/next arrows and dots
notes: Tab bar switching between 7 content panels is an interactive component; each panel's slides stay inside the tab panel.

usage: Use for a tab bar switching between product categories, each with one or more featured slides.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any tabbed content where panels contain image + text slides. Plain text tabs work too (a panel with no image is rendered as a single slide).
